title: 3 Duas for When Your Heart Is Heavy

captions.tiktok: 3 duas for when your heart is heavy, the words the Prophet, peace be upon him, turned to in grief. Sahih al-Bukhari 6369, Tirmidhi 2457, and the dua of Yunus, Qur'an 21:87.
captions.shorts: 3 prophetic duas for anxiety and grief. The third pulled a prophet out of the dark.
captions.reels: 3 duas for a heavy heart. The dua of Yunus, said in the darkness, was never refused.

segments.text: Everyone carries a weight they cannot always name. The Prophet Muhammad, peace be upon him, was given words for it.
Here are three short prayers, called dua, a personal call to God, for when your heart feels heavy.
segments.foot: dua = a personal prayer, calling on God.

segments.text: When worry pressed on him, he would say: O Allah, I seek refuge in You from anxiety and grief.
segments.arabicText: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنَ الْهَمِّ وَالْحَزَنِ
segments.foot: Sahih al-Bukhari 6369; also Abu Dawud 1555. Sahih.

segments.text: The second: send blessings upon the Prophet, peace be upon him. One man made all his prayers this, and his worries eased.
The third belongs to Yunus, peace be upon him, a prophet swallowed by a great fish. In the dark he cried: There is no god but You. Glory to You. I have done wrong.
segments.arabicText: لَّا إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا أَنتَ سُبْحَانَكَ إِنِّي كُنتُ مِنَ الظَّالِمِينَ
segments.foot: Qur'an 21:87 (Surah al-Anbiya). Yunus = the prophet Jonah.

segments.text: Darkness pressed on every side, yet he did not lose hope, and called the only One who could hear him there.
segments.foot: 'He called out within the darknesses' - Qur'an 21:87.

segments.text: And God answered. No one in sorrow speaks these words, it is said, without a reply.
segments.foot: Jami at-Tirmidhi 3505. Hasan; sahih per al-Albani.

segments.text: So when your heart is heavy, you are not alone, and never without words. Speak them softly, and wait for the light.
